depth_justification: The identical MDR Rule 11 / Class IIa analysis block is repeated verbatim four times with no new information, a serious looping defect, and the final report's dimension IDs are internally inconsistent and mismatched (e.g. [P2.D3] labeled 'Post-market surveillance', [P3.D1] for data protection). Some genuine app-specific engagement (Rule 11 reclassification, the actual data list) keeps it above 1.
actionability_justification: Most output is directional ('conduct a borderline analysis', 'engage a Notified Body', 'implement encryption') without concrete how-to, and the requested structured report is generic boilerplate with no implementable recipes. It did produce the requested deliverable, so it clears a 1.
salient_examples: Identical response to 'Class I MDD legacy ... might bump to IIa' repeated 4 times verbatim
[P2.D3] Post-market surveillance and vigilance ... [P3.D1] Data protection and privacy (IDs inconsistent with earlier turns and gold standard)
